items.desc: Engineered a cross-platform PWA for AI-powered face and scalp analysis deployed across retail outlet tablets in Singapore (iPad/Windows Surface), offloading 10,000+ image coordinate calculations to Web Workers to enable instant annotation toggling and smooth 60 FPS stylus editing while bypassing Safari WebKit canvas memory limits.

Designed an offline-first PWA data synchronization architecture, queueing 10,000+ scan coordinate payloads in IndexedDB during retail Wi-Fi dropouts to prevent data loss and ensure uninterrupted tablet consultations.
